focus.product: Heavy-equipment component rebuild and remanufactured parts (hydraulic cylinders, final drives and gears, engine parts), with hard-chrome and hardfacing
focus.why: Balikpapan already hosts the rebuild base: Komatsu/UT's KRA (since 1996), Trakindo's Balikpapan CRC (2026 posting), Liebherr's reman centre (opened Feb 2025) and independent re-chrome/machining shops (Duma Nusatama). PAMA runs mine sites in Paser, Kutai Timur, Kutai Kartanegara, Berau and Kutai Barat. Indonesia imported US$796M of 843149 parts and US$72M of hydraulic cylinders (841221) in 2025. Risk: RKAB coal quotas cut UT's Komatsu big-machine sales from 860 to 436 units (Jan-Aug 2026).

also.product: Oil and gas well-completion and wellhead parts (liner hangers, packers, bridge plugs, crossovers, wellhead/X-mas tree components, OCTG tubing finishing)
also.why: Four Balikpapan/Samarinda firms hold Kemenperin TKDN certificates for these parts at 25-67% local content (Mulia Jaya Mandiri, Sagatrade Murni, Besmindo Borneo Semesta, Grace Technic). Buyers include Pertamina Hulu Mahakam, PHKT and Pertamina Hulu Sanga-Sanga; RDMP Balikpapan was built at 30% TKDN. National imports in 2025: US$243M of 843143 and US$170M of 730429 tubing.

also.product: Pump and rotating-equipment repair parts (impellers, shafts, sleeves, seal parts) for the refinery, LNG and Bontang fertiliser/methanol plants
also.why: Sulzer runs a Balikpapan pump/turbine service centre with machine shop; Bhumi Phala Perkasa holds TKDN for API pump packages; buyers are concentrated: RU V (360,000 bpd after RDMP), Pupuk Kaltim (Pabrik-2 ammonia revamp, 2026), Kaltim Methanol, Kaltim Nitrate, Badak LNG.

Institut Teknologi Kalimantan (Balikpapan) ran 3D-printing/rapid-prototyping training for SMKN 5 and SMKN 2 Balikpapan (2020). Politeknik Negeri Samarinda not verified (site blocked).

focus.product: Mining and cement wear parts with hardfacing (bucket teeth and adapters, pins and bushings, liners, conveyor idler and pulley parts)
focus.why: Demand is large and close: BUMA's Adaro Tutupan contract (Tabalong) moves about 50.5 Mbcm of overburden and 9.3 Mt of coal a year to 2030; PAMA runs sites in Banjarbaru and Tanah Bumbu; Conch South Kalimantan Cement operates in Tabalong. RPIP Kalsel names 'Industri Logam' and mining-product processing as provincial priorities. Indonesia imported US$52M of buckets (843141) and US$212M of conveyor/handling parts (843139) in 2025. No local CNC wear-part maker was verified, so this is a capacity gap to fill.

also.product: Plantation and farm hand tools (dodos palm-harvesting chisels, parang, sabit) and forged blades
also.why: Hulu Sungai Selatan's RPIK 2019-2039 makes metal goods an 'industri unggulan', listing dodos, parang and sabit, smithing (pandai besi) and machining/turning services. Palm estates across Kalimantan are the buyers; CNC or laser blanking and controlled heat treatment would upgrade a forge-based trade. Imports of 820140/820190 are negligible (US$0.2M or less a year), so this means winning domestic demand, not replacing imports.

also.product: Cast-and-machined boat propellers and small farm-machinery parts (rice threshers, pumps)
also.why: The same HSS plan lists propeller casting, alsintan engineering (rice threshers, pumps) and machining services; a Tabalong sole proprietor holds a TKDN certificate (38%) for a petrol rice thresher. National propeller imports were US$27.7M in 2025.

focus.product: Palm-oil mill spare parts (screw-press worms and cages, digester arms, sprockets, conveyor flights), machined and hard-faced
focus.why: Weakly evidenced: 2026 wage decrees set separate minimums for palm plantations in several Kalteng regencies, and a CPO port operates at Kumai (Kotawaringin Barat), which points to a large mill base; no local machine shop was verified. focus.product: Alumina-refinery and smelter maintenance parts (slurry-pump wet-end parts, valve trims, wear liners, shafts and couplings)
focus.why: Mempawah is becoming a single large buyer: the SGAR refinery (about 1 Mt alumina a year from about 3.3 Mt bauxite) started in Sep 2024, and MIND ID began a Rp104.55T complex there in Feb 2026 (600,000 t/yr aluminium smelter plus a refinery phase the article calls 'SGAR Fase I', 1 Mt/yr; how this relates to the 2024 plant is unclear). ICA operates at Tayan. RPIP Kalbar makes bauxite processing a provincial priority (KI Ketapang). Kalbar has the lowest UMP in Kalimantan. No local supplier verified yet.

also.product: Palm-oil mill and crumb-rubber factory spare parts
also.why: RPIP Kalbar lists palm (KI Tayan) and rubber (KI Mandor) among its seven priority industries; 2026 sectoral minimums exist for palm plantations and the CPO industry in Ketapang, Bengkayang and Landak.

also.why: RPIP Kalbar's wood-industry plan names wood-based components (wood working, laminate, finger joint), wood moulding and furniture for 2017-2037.
